name: Text to Speech
description: Speak text using the system's built-in TTS engine with optional speed, volume, voice, script generation, and resume output.

dialogs.invalidNumberMessage: Use a valid numeric speech setting before running the tool.
dialogs.noResultMessage: The speech request completed. Enable Return Resume Output if you want run details shown here.
dialogs.successMessage: Speech completed and resume output was returned.

result.label: Speech Result
result.placeholder: Resume output will appear here when enabled.
result.noResultText: Speech completed. Enable Return Resume Output to display details here.

validationMessages.required: Enter the text you want the speech engine to read aloud.

parameters.name: Speed
parameters.label: Speed
parameters.description: Optional speech rate from -10 to 10. Higher values speak faster.

validationMessages.invalidNumber: Speed must be a valid number between -10 and 10.
validationMessages.integer: Speed must be a whole number between -10 and 10.
validationMessages.min: Speed cannot be lower than -10 for the Windows speech engine.
validationMessages.max: Speed cannot be higher than 10 for the Windows speech engine.

validationMessages.invalidNumber: Volume must be a valid number from 0 to 100.
validationMessages.integer: Volume must be a whole number from 0 to 100.

parameters.name: Generate
parameters.label: Generate Script
parameters.description: Generate a PowerShell speech script in the tool output folder.

parameters.name: Resume
parameters.label: Return Resume Output
parameters.description: Return the current speech settings after speaking the text.
